resources.string: Review the ordinary message under your own name. Applying it places text in your draft; you send it yourself.
Headings become bold text. Colors and special formatting are removed.
Tables become text with separate rows and columns.
Buttons with links become links in the text.
Interactive actions are removed and will no longer run.
Photos, videos, audio and files are not attached with this text.
Some unsupported parts could not be converted. Check the preview.
The message is too long or complex. Shorten it and try again.
Conversion could not be completed. Continue editing the original message.
There is no text to convert.
This rich message cannot be edited as ordinary text with the current account. Copy its text into a new draft or cancel; the original message will remain unchanged.
Wait for attachments to finish uploading before converting.
